corrupt-wo.nilfText:
QUEST WALKTHROUGH / VELEN

The Nilfgaardian Connection

Velen · Suggested level 5

Main quest
Travel to Velen.
Go to the Inn at the Crossroads.
Ask about the agent called Hendrik at the Inn at the Crossroads.
Finish talking to the innkeep about the agent called Hendrik.
Look for the agent called Hendrik in the village of Heatherton.
Talk to the survivor and learn what happened in the village.
Find the agent called Hendrik.
Search the agent’s hut using your Witcher Senses.
OBJECTIVE 1 OF 8
This is your next unfinished objective
0 of 8 required completed
Route-dependent, not counted yet: Defeat the baron’s men.
Arrival

Hanged Man’s Tree

SELECTED OBJECTIVE
Travel to Velen.
WHAT TO DO
After Imperial Audience, travel to Velen.
From the Hanged Man’s Tree signpost, follow The Nilfgaardian Connection toward the Inn at the Crossroads.
WHY

Check equipment condition and replenish supplies before taking the road.

Related quests and tasks
Funeral Pyres →

Fits the road: the priest west of Mulbrydale offers it. Completion is recorded in its own hub.

At the Mercy of Strangers →

Fits the road: the riverbank on the approach to the inn. Its decision is recorded in its own hub.

Innkeeper →

At the Inn at the Crossroads: food, drink and a shop conversation.

Collected notices →

Notices from the inn board, kept for later. Collecting a notice is not completing it.

Preparation & quest details
Story & correction controls

Reference tools

Return to hub

Sources
